| description = Another ogre, ugly as sin. He has a chance to spawn at the goblin camp near the entrance to Dagnor's Cauldron.  The spawn point is a small distance away from camp on the side with the flag.

The spawn time is about 7 minutes.  If you kill any wandering goblins on the road in BB, and then wait for this spawn and keep it dead.  Corflunk will spawn there.

He will path from there along the road, past the crossroads guard house, all the way to two guard houses near the entrance to Greater Faydark.

He can be incredibly annoying to track, despite being a big eye sore.
